meta.note: Transcribed from photographs of the cards and from the recordings of the read-aloud. Spelling and wording are as written; TUL and UL are the room's own shorthand. Groups D and E are known from their recordings only; their cards were not photographed. Two cards are partly cut off in the photographs: one of B's peer cards (the Aspen Institute) and one of C's impact cards.

headlines.text: TUL is federated across every US community, driving a deep understanding and development of autonomy and agency in every personal digital interaction, keeping citizens relevant and equal participants in the workforce, and AI policy.
headlines.spoken: We have Upskilling Labs federated across every US community, driving a deep understanding and development of autonomy and agency in every personal digital interaction, keeping citizens relevant and equal participants in the workforce and AI policy. So, super wordy. The big one there: proliferating across the country.
headlines.future: autonomy and agency in every personal digital interaction; citizens relevant and equal participants in the workforce and AI policy

headlines.text: TUL working with 100+ local + national govts + 10,000,000 upskillers
headlines.spoken: Upskilling Labs working with a hundred local and national governments plus 10 million upskillers globally. Bigger stakeholders, but keeping true to our main focus: helping local communities and individuals grow their skills, grow their confidence and build community.
headlines.position: working with 100+ local and national governments and 10 million upskillers

headlines.text: Every community that hosts an Upskilling Labs attracts private + public investment. Every member of that community is gainfully employed in a fulfilling role. Communities have what they need to solve problems for public & private sectors at the local, national & global levels.
headlines.spoken: Two statements. Every community that hosts an Upskilling Lab attracts private and public investment; every member of that community is gainfully employed in a fulfilling role. Communities have what they need to solve problems for public and private sectors at the local, national and global levels.
headlines.future: every member gainfully employed in a fulfilling role; communities have what they need to solve problems at every level
headlines.position: every community that hosts a Lab attracts private and public investment

headlines.text: The Upskilling Labs community and workforce model is leading in human agency development; other nations race to adopt it.
headlines.spoken: The Upskilling Labs community and workforce model is leading in human agency development; other nations race to adopt it. We believe in a future of work that's still human-driven, that we've created a system for producing those outcomes, and that others find value in it and use it, at scale, such that we're actually a new institution, whether private or public.
headlines.future: a future of work that is still human-driven
headlines.position: the model leading in human agency development; other nations race to adopt it

headlines.text: A successful Lab in every city, in every country, for everyone, in every industry, in less than 10 years.
headlines.spoken: A successful Lab in every city, in every country, for everyone, in every industry, in less than 10 years. We thought about proliferating beyond what it was originally created for, and making sure it's open access for anyone who wants to learn.
headlines.position: a Lab in every city, in every country, for everyone, in every industry
